title: FilterCommand
description:
FilterCommand: Contains the result of processing a filter request into SQL components. 
Includes the generated WHERE clause and associated parameters for safe query execution.

WhereClause.description: The SQL WHERE clause generated from the filter, without the 'WHERE' keyword.

Parameters.description:
Dictionary of parameter names and values for safe parameterised query execution. 
Keys are parameter names (including @ prefix), values are the parameter values.

FilterType.description: The type of filter that generated this result (e.g., 'Equality', 'Range', 'Combined').

Limit.description: Optional limit on the number of results to return. Zero means no limit.

TableName.description: Optional table name the filter is intended for. Can be used for validation.

OrderByClause.description: The SQL ORDER BY clause generated from sort specifications, without the 'ORDER BY' keyword.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
